definitions.name: gtfs_ride
definitions.comment: A planned ride along a route, populated daily from MOT GTFS data.

columns.name: first_gtfs_ride_stop_id
columns.comment: First gtfs_ride_stop.id, populated by ride aggregation.

columns.name: last_gtfs_ride_stop_id
columns.comment: Last gtfs_ride_stop.id, populated by ride aggregation.

definitions.name: gtfs_ride_stop
definitions.comment: A planned stop along a GTFS ride, populated daily from MOT GTFS data.

definitions.name: gtfs_route
definitions.comment: A planned route, relevant for the specified date and populated daily from MOT GTFS data.

definitions.name: gtfs_stop
definitions.comment: A stop, relevant for the specified date and populated daily from MOT GTFS data.

definitions.name: siri_ride_durations
definitions.comment: Observed first and last vehicle locations per SIRI ride, with duration calculated after six hours without observations.

definitions.name: siri_ride_gtfs_ride
definitions.comment: Matches SIRI rides to GTFS rides by scheduled start time, line, and operator; ambiguous matches remain null.

definitions.name: siri_ride_stop_gtfs_stop
definitions.comment: Matches SIRI ride stops to GTFS stops by service date and stop code; ambiguous matches remain null.

definitions.name: siri_vehicle_location
definitions.comment: Raw SIRI vehicle observations partitioned by snapshot, with derived route, ride, stop, and observation identifiers.
definitions.partitionBy: format('{0}/{1}/{2}', splitByChar('/', siri_snapshot_id)[1], splitByChar('/', siri_snapshot_id)[2], splitByChar('/', siri_snapshot_id)[3])

definitions.name: siri_vehicle_location_distance_from_gtfs_stop
definitions.comment: Distance in meters from each distinct SIRI ride-stop vehicle position to its matched GTFS stop.

definitions.name: siri_ride
definitions.comment: SIRI rides aggregated from vehicle observations, with the latest observed duration and GTFS ride match.
definitions.as: select siri_vehicle_location.siri_ride_id as id, siri_route_id, journey_ref, scheduled_start_time, vehicle_ref, first_vehicle_location_id, last_vehicle_location_id, duration_minutes, gtfs_ride_id from ( select siri_ride_id, any(siri_route_id) as siri_route_id, any(journey_ref) as journey_ref, any(scheduled_start_time) as scheduled_start_time, any(vehicle_ref) as vehicle_ref from siri_vehicle_location group by siri_ride_id ) AS siri_vehicle_location left outer join ( select siri_ride_id, argMax(first_vehicle_location_id, calculated_at) as first_vehicle_location_id, argMax(last_vehicle_location_id, calculated_at) as last_vehicle_location_id, argMax(duration_minutes, calculated_at) as duration_minutes from siri_ride_durations group by siri_ride_id ) AS siri_ride_durations on siri_ride_durations.siri_ride_id = siri_vehicle_location.siri_ride_id left outer join ( select siri_ride_id, argMax(gtfs_ride_id, calculated_at) as gtfs_ride_id from siri_ride_gtfs_ride group by siri_ride_id ) AS siri_ride_gtfs_ride on siri_ride_gtfs_ride.siri_ride_id = siri_vehicle_location.siri_ride_id

definitions.name: siri_ride_durations_refresh
definitions.comment: Appends recalculated rows to siri_ride_durations every 10 minutes.
definitions.as: SELECT siri_ride_id, argMin(id, tuple(recorded_at_time, id)) AS first_vehicle_location_id, argMax(id, tuple(recorded_at_time, id)) AS last_vehicle_location_id, min(recorded_at_time) AS first_recorded_at_time, max(recorded_at_time) AS last_recorded_at_time, if( first_recorded_at_time < last_recorded_at_time AND last_recorded_at_time < now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR, toNullable( toInt32( round( dateDiff( 'second', first_recorded_at_time, last_recorded_at_time ) / 60.0 ) ) ), NULL ) AS duration_minutes, now() AS calculated_at FROM siri_vehicle_location AS siri_vehicle_location WHERE recorded_at_time > now() - INTERVAL 10 DAY and scheduled_start_time > now() - INTERVAL 9 DAY GROUP BY siri_ride_id

definitions.name: siri_ride_gtfs_ride_refresh
definitions.comment: Appends recalculated rows to siri_ride_gtfs_ride every 10 minutes.
definitions.as: select siri_ride_id, if(min(gtfs.gtfs_ride_id) = max(gtfs.gtfs_ride_id), min(gtfs.gtfs_ride_id), NULL) as gtfs_ride_id, now() as calculated_at from ( select gtfs_ride.id gtfs_ride_id, gtfs_ride.start_time, gtfs_route.line_ref, gtfs_route.operator_ref from gtfs_ride AS gtfs_ride inner join gtfs_route AS gtfs_route on gtfs_route.id = gtfs_ride.gtfs_route_id where gtfs_route.date >= today() - INTERVAL 9 DAY ) as gtfs inner join ( select siri_ride_id, any(line_ref) as line_ref, any(operator_ref) as operator_ref, any(scheduled_start_time) as scheduled_start_time from siri_vehicle_location where recorded_at_time >= now() - INTERVAL 10 DAY group by siri_ride_id ) siri on gtfs.start_time = siri.scheduled_start_time and toString(gtfs.line_ref) = siri.line_ref and toString(gtfs.operator_ref) = siri.operator_ref group by siri_ride_id

definitions.name: siri_ride_stop_gtfs_stop_refresh
definitions.comment: Appends recalculated rows to siri_ride_stop_gtfs_stop every 10 minutes.
definitions.as: select siri_ride_stop_id, gtfs.gtfs_stop_id as gtfs_stop_id, now() as calculated_at from ( select date as stop_day, toString(code) as stop_code, if(min(id) = max(id), min(id), NULL) as gtfs_stop_id from gtfs_stop AS gtfs_stop where gtfs_stop.date >= today() - INTERVAL 9 DAY group by stop_day, stop_code ) as gtfs inner join ( select siri_ride_stop_id, any(stop_code) as stop_code, any(scheduled_start_time) as scheduled_start_time from siri_vehicle_location AS siri_vehicle_location where recorded_at_time >= now() - INTERVAL 10 DAY group by siri_ride_stop_id ) siri on gtfs.stop_day = toDate32(siri.scheduled_start_time) and gtfs.stop_code = siri.stop_code

definitions.name: siri_vehicle_location_distance_from_gtfs_stop_refresh
definitions.comment: Appends recalculated rows to siri_vehicle_location_distance_from_gtfs_stop every 10 minutes.
definitions.as: SELECT positions.siri_ride_stop_id AS siri_ride_stop_id, positions.vehicle_location_latitude AS vehicle_location_latitude, positions.vehicle_location_longitude AS vehicle_location_longitude, round(geoDistance(positions.longitude, positions.latitude, gtfs.coordinates.2, gtfs.coordinates.1)) AS distance_from_gtfs_stop_meters, now() AS calculated_at FROM ( SELECT siri_ride_stop_id, vehicle_location_latitude, vehicle_location_longitude, toFloat64OrNull(vehicle_location_latitude) AS latitude, toFloat64OrNull(vehicle_location_longitude) AS longitude FROM siri_vehicle_location PREWHERE recorded_at_time >= now() - INTERVAL 10 DAY WHERE latitude BETWEEN 29 AND 34 AND longitude BETWEEN 32 AND 36 GROUP BY siri_ride_stop_id, vehicle_location_latitude, vehicle_location_longitude ) AS positions INNER JOIN ( SELECT siri_ride_stop_id, gtfs_stop_id FROM siri_ride_stop_gtfs_stop FINAL WHERE gtfs_stop_id IS NOT NULL ) AS matches ON matches.siri_ride_stop_id = positions.siri_ride_stop_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT id, min(tuple(assumeNotNull(lat), assumeNotNull(lon))) AS coordinates FROM gtfs_stop WHERE date >= today() - INTERVAL 9 DAY AND lat BETWEEN 29 AND 34 AND lon BETWEEN 32 AND 36 GROUP BY id ) AS gtfs ON gtfs.id = matches.gtfs_stop_id
